title: Hot-Reload Manager zero-downtime pack updates
description: Plugin Manifest Hot-Reload Manager performs hot reload of capability pack modules without core restart.
expected_behavior: HotReloadManager registers a pack module, detects file changes via checksum, and performs an atomic module swap with latency < 100ms.

acceptance_criteria.zero_downtime: Reload completes with old module still accessible
acceptance_criteria.rollback: Failed reload returns error without losing old module

test_steps.expected: Returns HotReloadResult with success=False and error set
